replies.author: Riskayyy
replies.body:
Hello 99!

This is one strange report, as we barely get reports of players hacking in lobbies. After a long thought on what to do, I've come to a conclusion to punish jcmycraft. Water walking usually means having a hacked client loaded. Who knows if he was hacking on public matches.

Thanks, and have an amazing day!
